look: Session board on a dot-grid desk: an AI invoice that arrives next month, Gateway's cost-estimate formula, the formula filled with illustrative numbers, a candidate chain where the over-budget model is skipped, and the gateway end card. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for what is wrong, jade for what is right.

scenes.desc: An AI invoice lands next month; the budget should act now.
scenes.name: Hook

scenes.desc: Gateway estimates each candidate model's cost before calling it.
scenes.name: Formula appears

scenes.desc: Input tokens plus maximum output, at that model's prices.
scenes.name: Numbers fill

scenes.desc: The over-budget tile greys out and the chain moves on.
scenes.name: Tile greys out

scenes.desc: End card with the gateway mark: spend as a routing decision.
scenes.name: Gateway

title: Put a budget on every model call
